tools.description: Disassemble instructions from a Mach-O binary with Capstone, starting at a virtual address or a symbol. Lines show address, bytes, instruction, and the symbol a branch lands on.
tools.name: disassemble

address.description: Start: a virtual address in hex (0x100003f50) or decimal, or a symbol name (_main or main).

arch.description: Slice of a fat file to read. Defaults to arm64e, then arm64, then the first slice.

binary.description: Path to a Mach-O file (thin or fat) this process can read.

tools.description: List the symbol table (LC_SYMTAB) of a Mach-O binary, nm-style, sorted by address.
tools.name: symbols

arch.description: Slice of a fat file to read. Defaults to arm64e, then arm64, then the first slice.

binary.description: Path to a Mach-O file (thin or fat) this process can read.

filter.description: Only symbols whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

kind.description: Defined, undefined (imports), or all. Default all.

offset.description: Matching symbols to skip, for paging. Default 0.

output.description: text: the page inline (default). file: every matching symbol, unpaged, as a text/plain attachment, with a one-line summary inline.
